source.title: GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP v4)
source.agency: NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies

insights.title: The poles sound different
insights.description: In 2016 the Arctic band was +3.23°C relative to its baseline. The Antarctic band was +0.35°C. Listen as the interval between them changes.

insights.title: A larger shift in the Arctic
insights.description: From the 1980s to 2016–2025, the Arctic band’s decade mean rose +2.38°C. The global mean rose +0.77°C over the same windows.

insights.title: Three unusually warm years
insights.description: The global annual estimates for 2023, 2024 and 2025 are +1.17°C, +1.28°C and +1.19°C. NASA describes 2023 and 2025 as effectively tied within uncertainty.
